purpose: Detector-only retrospective bridge from the P0-S2A mainline. Keep the exact historical rows, 40/20 roles, family6-level local representation and fitted head, step-max locator, threshold objective, access tier and grouped bootstrap while replacing only the calibration-only mixed-v2 DUFS-LIU complete-answer detector with the maximum of the same fitted local-risk curve. P0-S2I is a completed side interaction control and is not the parent of this state.

single_changed_factor.to: maximum of the fitted family6 level local-risk curve

fixed_factors.evaluation_role: historical deterministic 20 percent audit per family
fixed_factors.threshold_objective: historical calibration-role ProcessBench macro F1 within each scorer cell
fixed_factors.threshold_tie_break: first maximum in stable descending risk sweep
fixed_factors.scorer_copy_grouping: same source-question draw carries both scorer copies
fixed_factors.supervision: labels only for the unchanged historical threshold and metrics

bootstrap_contract: Paired source-question bootstrap. A family-unit draw carries both scorer copies and both S2A/S2B predictions; family estimates are averaged before the four-family macro contrast.
hard_fail_conditions: any registered S2A source, artifact, dependency, runner or registry hash differs
any S2A unit, target, locator, prediction, score, threshold or metric fails reconstruction within 1e-12
the 1270-row, 635-source-question population or its grouping hash changes
any factor besides the answer detector changes
the purely-local detector does not use the same fitted family6 level curve as the unchanged locator
a label enters the local curve fit
any later representation, split or population bridge is opened in the same run

mutation_boundary.method_fit: CPU label-free calibration-only family6 trajectory head
